package.name: ichava/icon-sets-openmoji
package.title: OpenMoji
package.description: OpenMoji emoji in two sets (colour and black outline), Unicode emoji 16.0, grouped by Unicode CLDR category. Moved verbatim from ichava/icon-sets-twemoji, which now ships Twemoji only.

default.name: Default
default.description: OpenMoji's own style in each set

openmoji-color.name: OpenMoji Color
openmoji-color.description: Community-driven flat colourful emojis from HfG Schwäbisch Gmünd (CC-BY-SA 4.0). Default set.

openmoji-black.name: OpenMoji Black
openmoji-black.description: Monochrome outline variant of OpenMoji (CC-BY-SA 4.0). Ideal for single-colour designs.

update_command._note: Refreshed by ichava/icon-sets-sync from config/icon-sets-openmoji.json, through its `openmoji-sets` recipe: both sets from one pinned hfg-gmuend/openmoji release tag, categorised by the Unicode taxonomy, with the guards that keep every icon. The weekly sync-upstream run here calls it. ichava/icon-sets-twemoji no longer carries OpenMoji, so this pack is its only home.

upstream._vendored_note: The files were moved verbatim from ichava/icon-sets-twemoji, where they were produced from OpenMoji 15.1.0 and categorised with Unicode emoji 16.0 (emoji-test.txt).
